title: Pocket mode not working on edge case
body:
##### Description

Pocket mode seems to break under some very specific circumstances. This was actually reported in [this other issue](https://gitlab.com/juanitobananas/wave-up/issues/107#note_71101415) but I am creating this new one to keep it a little cleaner.

##### Steps to reproduce

Conversation with @paulie-g:

>> Covering the sensor, waiting for the device to lock, then quickly uncovering it again results in no unlock at that time and, presumably, some sort of inconsistent internal state that prevents sensor uncovering working to unlock again. I can unlock by other means, which fixes internal state presumably, and everything works from then on.

> I haven't been able to reproduce this, but I'll keep on trying. Does WaveUp lock the device for you or is it Android's natural timeout doing that?
>> Did this not happen on older versions? It's a little weird that this appeared now.

This may have happened on older versions, I couldn't swear that it didn't - it's an edge case triggered by actually testing rather than normal usage. I care that it locks properly much more than I care about the unlock since I have double tap to wake, so a transient error like this wouldn't bother me.

To reproduce, set wave mode to off, pocket mode on, lock screen on, lock in landscape off, cover time to 1s, vibrate to on, workaround to off. Cover the sensor, wait for the second vibration + click from lock, uncover right away. This breaks pocket mode. I seem to recall from when I initially went through the code that there's a timeout there somewhere after it registers an event from the sensor, does something and before another event can be triggered. These are the settings I use with my flip cover. If I turn wave mode on, it allows me to bypass this - opening the cover again quickly after lock won't work, but closing/opening cover the second time unlocks successfully.

title: Android Pie new onSensorChanged policy doesn't allow WaveUp to run without a ForegroundService
body:
Due to the 'Privacy Changes' listed [here](https://developer.android.com/about/versions/pie/android-9.0-changes-all), apps aren't allowed to read sensor data without using a ForegroundService, i.e. showing a notification.

Unfortunately disabling battery optimization doesn't solve the issue. WaveUp still runs in the background, and although registering a proximity sensor listener works, it doesn't receive any events when the sensor changes.

Disabling WaveUp notifications from Android's notification settings doesn't work either.

I can only think of two possible pieful solutions:

- Don't allow to hide the notification (I personally don't like the notification so I'd like to be able to hide it)
- Try to hide the notification using the 'Grant notification access' permission, which I don't know if is even possible.

Edit: I thought that permanently showing the notification (using a ForegroundService) solved the issue, but this is not the case.

title: ANR while checking for root from UI with libsuperuser
body:
Executing su is similar to heavy I/O operations in terms of (slow) performance and should therefore not be called from the main thread.

Check if there is a better way to check for su from a non-UI thread. Making sure that the UI reacts accordingly, i.e. setting "root work-around" to false if the user doesn't allow super user privileges or probably after a certain timeout.

According to the Google Play Store statistics it doesn't seem to affect a lot of devices, but it does happen once in a while.

title: [FR] Perte quotidienne du statut "Application de filtrage d'appels par défaut" (conflit Family Link)
body:
## Description du problème
Sur les appareils Android supervisés par **Google Family Link**, Saracroche perd son statut d'application par défaut pour l'identification de l'appelant et le spam de manière cyclique (généralement après la période de "Temps de repos" nocturne). L'utilisateur doit redéfinir manuellement Saracroche comme application par défaut chaque matin.

## Étapes pour reproduire
1. Installer Saracroche sur un appareil enfant géré via Family Link.
2. Accorder les autorisations et définir Saracroche comme application de filtrage par défaut.
3. Attendre le déclenchement du "Temps de repos" de Family Link (ou attendre 24h).
4. Vérifier les paramètres système des applications par défaut.

## Comportement attendu
L'application devrait conserver son statut d'application par défaut de manière permanente, comme sur un profil Android standard.

## Comportement actuel
Le paramètre revient sur "Aucun" ou sur l'application système, désactivant le filtrage automatique jusqu'à une intervention manuelle.

## Environnement
- **Modèle de l'appareil :** Redmi note 14 4G
- **Contexte :** Appareil sous supervision parentale (Google Family Link).

I ran into this issue now twice with the latest F-Droid version (16.2).

The first time, I paused a (bicycle) track, then stopped it and later resumed it.
The second time, the track paused automatically (probably due to long idle time), then I stopped it and later resumed it.

In both cases, the order of the waypoints (2s interval sampling values) gets screwed up, i.e. some waypoints of the second (after resume) part of the journey get interleaved/sorted before some waypoints of the first part of the journey.

Exporting the track as GPX shows that the entries themselves (`trkpt`) are all correct and sorting them by ascending timestamp results in the expected overall track.

I am not 100% sure about this point, but this issue also seems to occur only when stopping the track the second/final time. While the track is still running, **I think**, the displayed distance and route values were okay.

So I guess a simple work-around would be to just forcefully sort the waypoints by their timestamps on stopping a track...

title: Editing duration to be shorter than the actual workout breaks the speed graph
body:
If you manually edit the workout duration to be shorter than the actual workout, the speed graph breaks.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Edit a workout
2. Make the duration shorter than the actual workout
3. View the speed graph

### Observations

It seems that the graph isn't cut off, but instead squished to fit the new workout duration. When I click on the broken speed graph, and zoom in and out, the graph fixes itself. This can be seen in the three screenshots. One shows how the graph looks in the workout view, another show what it looks like after clicking the graph and the last one shows how it looks like after zooming in and out.

### Ideas for a solution

- Disable the ability to edit workout duration
    I'm not sure what the correct behavior in this case would be. Let's say a workout, a run, took 2 hours, and a user changed the duration to one hour. The new speed graph could either show

    - The first half (seems arbitrary)
    - The second half (also arbitrary)
    - The whole, but stretched (this kind of makes sense but physically doesn't, for the speed, distance and duration to still match up, all the speed values would be multiplied by two )

- Allow the user to change the workout duration, but only change it cosmetically, as a note for the user.
    I think this makes the most sense. The Duration and Paused duration we can see now would be unchangeable by the user, but the user could mess around with another value, like "Total duration", that would basically just be a note for the user.

### Notes

- App version 16.2
- Kind of related to https://codeberg.org/jannis/FitoTrack/issues/684
- Also, editing the duration is very buggy (the cursor keeps moving, hard to enter numbers), but this might be another issue

title: Editing workout breaks duration
body:
### Steps to reproduce:

1. Open a workout that has a pause duration (attachment before.png)
2. Tap the three dots on the top right and click `Edit Workout`
3. Click `Save` (you can change things but you don't need to to reproduce) (attachment edit.png)
4. Now, the Duration of the workout has changed. It can even go into the negatives. (attachment after.png)

### Cause

The cause seems quite simple. When you open a workout, you see two durations, one is called `Duration`, but is actually the "Moving duration". The second one is called `Paused duration`, and is the "Pause duration".

When you edit the Workout, one of the fields is `Duration`. It's default value is the one from "Moving duration" (also called Duration). The problem is that this value actually corresponds to the "Total duration" of the workout.

When a user click to edit the workout and saves it, the total duration is changed to the Moving duration, the paused duration remains unchanged. This means that by clicking save, the paused duration is subtracted from the moving duration, and this can go into the negatives.

### Possible solutions

I can think of a few solution, but I'm not that familiar with the app, so they might be bad.

- Remove the option to edit the duration of a workout
    I personally don't see a reason to edit the duration of a workout, but I believe there might be uses for this feature. 
    
- Add another field to the edit view, and allow the user to change both the "Duration" and the "Paused duration"

- Rename the field that's shown when editing to "Total duration", and adjust it's default value accordingly (Duration + Paused duration)


If the feature to edit duration stays, I think there should also be a feature to edit paused duration. It feels weird to allow changing only one of them.


### Notes

- App version 16.2
- Related to https://codeberg.org/jannis/FitoTrack/issues/685
- The workout can be fixed by exporting it as a GPX-file and importing it back. The duration is set to the correct amount.

title: Bug: incorrect end time after editing a workout
body:
Hello, dear developers and contributors!

I've been recording my bicycle rides with FitoTrack 15.3 recently and noted that it displays incorrect time of activity ending. I attach 3 screenshots, and it appears that the time of activity ending in FitoTrack is not simply the phone's time at the moment when the recording is stopped. Instead, the time of activity ending seems to be calculated by adding the duration of the activity (active time) to the start time. However, idle (pause) time is not added, which results in wrong ending time.

The relevant data from the screenshots is summarized in the table below. Displayed End Time values look like sums of Start Time and Active Time values. If one adds Idle Time values to Displayed End Time values, Correct End Time values will be achieved, they correspond to reality.

| Date   | Start Time | Active Time | Displayed End Time | Idle Time | Correct End Time |
| ------ | ---------- | ----------- | ------------------ | --------- | ---------------- |
| 16 May | 13:22:21   | 3:35:03     | 16:57:25           | 3:41:09   | 19:38:36         |
| 21 May | 11:24:59   | 2:44:09     | 14:09:08           | 1:29:52   | 15:39:00         |
| 26 May | 12:29:34   | 3:58:02     | 16:27:36           | 2:07:04   | 18:34:40         |

Edit 1: what I call "Active Time" here is called "Duration" in FitoTrack (which seems misleading to me).

Edit 2: the bug occurs with the Other type of activity as well (not only with bicycling).

Edit 3: this bug is not persistent, some of the recorded rides have correct end time displayed, and I cannot discern any apparent difference between the recordings with correct and incorrect end times.

Edit 4: luckily, actual end time is preserved in the recordings, so it is displayed in other applications after exporting FitoTrack's recordings as GPX files.

P.S. Otherwise, I'm totally happy with FitoTrack's recording quality, reliable autopause and low battery consumption. Thanks for it!

title: [BUG-1] Corriger les fuites de Cursor dans contactAllowed()
body:
## Description

Le `Cursor` retourné par `ContentResolver.query()` n'est pas fermé quand `count == 0`, provoquant une fuite mémoire progressive.

## Fichiers concernés

- `EventReceiver.kt` (ligne 159-166)
- `NotificationService.kt` (lignes 617-630)

## Correctif attendu

Remplacer le pattern :
```kotlin
val c = resolver.query(...)
if (c != null && c.count > 0) {
    c.close()
    true
} else {
    false  // Cursor non fermé !
}
```
Par :
```kotlin
resolver.query(...)?.use { cursor ->
    cursor.count > 0
} ?: false
```

**Réf.** : SECURITY.md §4, FEATURES.md BUG-1

title: Fix "Reconnect with TCP" button
body:
A user reported a problem where the eduVPN app no longer offers the "Prefer / Force TCP" option in the settings which result in a problem in the following situation: when the server offers OpenVPN+UDP, but UDP does NOT work properly, e.g. MTU issues, there is no fallback to OpenVPN+TCP possible. This results in the user being unable to connect to the VPN as there is no manual override for TCP possible.

Approaches:

1. Restore the "Prefer/Force" TCP option
2. Implement online detection for OpenVPN+UDP as well

title: do not show "Reconnect with TCP" when not available
body: We discovered at least 1 scenario where "Reconnect with TCP" was shown when it is not available: if a profile only has TCP + OpenVPN which means that the VPN *is* already using TCP.

title: client `iss` validation broken
body:
vpn-user-portal 3.7.0 removed the trailing `/`' from the `iss` value in the OAuth response. The Android app 3.2.2 uses an `eduvpn-common` library that enforces that the `iss` returned is the same as the `base_uri` of the server in the discovery file.

Later versions of `eduvpn-common` removed this `iss` check as it broke a number of servers _anyway_, independent of vpn-user-portal version.

We need to release an app with updates eduvpn-common library.

Make sure that upper limit on request timeouts to back end work
body: If the user selects a two minute timeout, the network client of the underlying request may time out before the timeout that was externally set in settings. Make sure that the network client code doesn't abort the connection before the wrapper on the future code.

body: This can happen if a user downgrades the version of the app that they have installed while keeping the database the same.

title: Review conditionals in requestAndEnableNotifications
body: Review conditionals in `requestAndEnableNotifications`. Should they be more similar to `requestBatteryPermission`?

title: Changing the sync timeout doesn't apply to current sync
body: If the user selects a 2 minute timeout and then a sync starts, the sync continues as long as there is a server that is dropping all requests. If the user then goes to the settings to shorten that time, to 5 seconds, then when they return to the alerts screen, the previous sync is still occurring for the remaining time. After that, the sync time is the shorter 5 seconds. The new timeout perhaps should apply to the current sync. However this is only an issue if one server is unresponsive, and the user had a long timeout selected previously.

title: Only run foreground service if there's one or more accounts configured
body: Otherwise, a notification appears despite nothing to sync, and the app runs in the background, draining the battery.

title: Close the on-screen keyboard settings icon in Android 16 emulator
body: When entering text in the Android 16 emulator, if I use the tab or enter key to switch between fields when adding a new alert source, a keyboard options window appears over the screen and may remain after that screen is closed, depending on precisely which steps are taken to switch fields and submit the form. This may be an emulator feature, and not part of Android, but someone may run into this with an external keyboard on Android.

title: Is "lastSeen" not always updated at the right times?
body: I recall that the various triggers for updating that value were approximate, because I didn't know how to monitor some combination of the app being visible, changing visibility and which view was active. I should revisit this, because sometimes the alert notification messages can be confusing, even if they are correct in a way. A new notification should only show up if there was a new alert since the last time that the alerts were refreshed and seen. And if they were not seen, and occurred before the latest refresh, they would be included in stats about any new alerts, but would not trigger a notification / sound themselves. So they would piggyback on brand new alert notifications. Anyhow, I should revisit this and make sure that updating lastSeen is 100% correct, because it affects notifications, including when the app is in focus.

title: Add a quick way to pause/unpause the game
body:
Currently, the game, once paused _(I don't know the full list of ways to do this, but I've done it unintentionally quite often)_, can only be unpaused by opening the system menu, selecting Pause, and then clicking the Continue button in the pop-up. This is quite a long way, especially when the player repeatedly pauses the game by accident and does not know how to prevent it.

The most convenient option for the user would be to set (remap) a key in the application settings that would pause the game. And only this key (as well as all pop-ups) will activate the pause. An attempt to assign any action for the game to this key will generate a conflict warning.

title: Jukebox mode: Ultrasonic can fail to send 'start' action; possible race condition
body:
## Problem description

I am helping to test the recent implementation of Jukebox mode in Navidrome, currently still under development. See [here](https://github.com/navidrome/navidrome/issues/364) and [here](https://github.com/navidrome/navidrome/pull/2554).

I've discovered an issue when testing with Ultrasonic that I'm fairly sure (but not certain) shows an issue with Ultrasonic.

The issue concerns starting playback with an empty queue. Usually this fails. The direct cause is that (as revealed with Wireshark) the `start` command is never sent to Navidrome. Ultrasonic does however start polling the Jukebox for a change in status, and if playback is started manually via a different method (e.g. just sending the start command manually with curl), Ultrasonic picks this up and begins to work - including letting you play, pause, and select new songs.

### Steps to reproduce

If you want to test the precise thing I'm testing, you will need a build of Navidrome from the latest master branch with [these changes](https://github.com/navidrome/navidrome/pull/2554) applied on top.

1. Check that jukebox mode is enabled. Clear the queue in Ultrasonic. Enable logging in Ultrasonic, force stop it, and stop Navidrome. Start both. Double check that the queue is cleared.
2. Try to play a song in Ultrasonic.

### Please provide a log!

I will link the log below but it appears to be useless. What turned out to be way more useful is a combination of Wireshark and adb logcat. Whenever playback fails, I see the following output in logcat:

```
10-12 14:13:33.344 23818 23818 W MCImplBase: Controller isn't allowed to call command= 2
10-12 14:13:33.344 23818 23818 W MCImplBase: Controller isn't allowed to call command= 10
10-12 14:13:33.344 23818 23818 W MCImplBase: Controller isn't allowed to call command= 2
10-12 14:13:33.344 23818 23818 W MCImplBase: Controller isn't allowed to call command= 1
```

The player appears to be failing on the play and pause commands (1 and 2). This is correlated with what I notice from Wireshark - that Ultrasonic fails to send the `start` command.

I wasn't able to work out the internal logic of Ultrasonic with a quick look, but this could easily be the source of the problem. Ultrasonic "wants" to send the start command (call [play](https://gitlab.com/ultrasonic/ultrasonic/-/blob/develop/ultrasonic/src/main/kotlin/org/moire/ultrasonic/service/JukeboxMediaPlayer.kt#L152)?), but Android says it isn't allowed to. Maybe this is because Android thinks the playback queue is empty?

In any case, Ultrasonic ends up stuck in this state. It needs to send the `start` command but won't allow itself to do that. You get similar controller warnings in this state if you try to press the play button.

Sending the `start` command manually seems to bypass the issue, because (as long as polling is occurring!) it convinces the controller that the play and pause operations are available. Once fixed, playback is usually stable, but clearing the queue sometimes (but not always?) breaks it again.

Log: [ultrasonic.log](/uploads/97a59a6853463fa8e7ec2aa12229d1b1/ultrasonic.log)

## System information

### Ultrasonic client

 * **Ultrasonic version**: 4.7.1-fdroid
 * **Android version**: 12
 * **Device info**: Samsung Galaxy S10e

### Server

 * **Server name**: Navidrome
 * **Server version**: latest vcs + patch
 * **Protocol used**: http

## Additional notes

Happy to provide any additional information that would help narrow this down further.

title: Playlist items are duplicated automatically
body:
I have been using Ultrasonic with Subsonic for many years.   Currently v 4.8.0 via Google Play.   

I typically add items to a running playlist using the "play after" button or simply by selcting all tracks and then "play" from my media library.  After a while I delete the playlist and start over.   I rarely add more than 30 items and I dont save the playlists.  

I have noticed many times that, after a while, my playlist repeats the same items several times.  For example, if I add 15 tracks then those same 15 tracks appear again after track 15 as tracks 16 to 30.   Eventually they repeat 3, 4 or more times until I have the same set of tracks listed over and over in my playlist.  

Because I use Ultrasonic only occasionally, I don't know what triggers this.  I have noticed then when I try to edit the playlist to remove some of the duplicate tracks, the entire playlisy is sometimes cleared instead.

But today I opened the app after at least month of inactivity and found that the 20-odd songs in my playlist had grown to 13,000+ items all copies of the original 20 songs repeated over and over.   As I was scrolling around I saw a "playlist empty" message and then these same 20 songs populated the playlist 26,000 times!   See the attached image (when I figure out how to add it)

I don't have any idea what causes this, but I have noticed that my trying to edit the playlist sometimes results in it being removed entirely when I don't request that action, and I think that these two events - removal and doubling - are related.

I am using Oxygen OS 14.0 on a OnePlus 10 Pro.  Subsonic is a licensed version, up to date.

title: Next song in playlist fails to play, every track has to be played manually
body:
## Problem description

When I queue a playlist of tracks, only the first track will play, playback will then stop once the track finishes. This issue does NOT happen when using Android 'DSub' app to play music from the same server.

### Steps to reproduce

1 - in Ultrasonic app click on Media Library
2 - Click on any album, then click the 'Play' button at top-right. The whole album is queued up to play, and the first track starts playing.
3 - The first tracks finished playing, and nothing happens afterwards.
Expectation: Play should continue to next track.

### Please provide a log!

(log to be attached)

## System information

### Ultrasonic client

Ultrasonic version: 
Android version: 14 / using CalyxOS v5.3.0
Device info: Google, Pixel 5

### Server

Server: Ampache
Server version: (docker hub latest - v6.2.1 from https://hub.docker.com/r/ampache/ampache/ )
Protocol: http

## Additional notes

Running via Tailscale tailnet, however that is the case for DSub also - which does not exhibit this issue.

title: App crashes when custom cache location is selected

title: Missing SSL certificate causes crashes on some devices
body:
On certain Android devices, the application crashes on successful reload of the plan with the following error:

```
java.security.cert.CertPathValidatorException: Trust anchor for certification path not found
    at com.android.org.conscrypt.TrustManagerImp.checkTrustedRecursive(TrustManagerImpl.java:677)
    ...
```

This seems to occur regardless of HTTP client on versions 2.2 - 2.2.2.

The error seemingly occurs because the server of `dsbmobile.de` uses the SSL/TLS certificate "Sectigo Public Server Authentication CA DV R36" where the corresponding client sometimes doesn't have it installed.

title: Scroll-Through doesn't work on large number of replacements
body: Because of how the UI is built, replacements of the current day can push the ones of the next day so far down that they aren't accessible. One scrollable list in which all replacements are listed would be preferable.

title: Out of sync on *some* devices.
body:
Happens on my phone but I can't reproduce this in emulator. but it is live.
Repro: set a repeating note on the 1s - set the tempo to 60.
The  first two notes will stay on 120bpm, then the rest of the song is out of sync.

The issue also occurs on an empty song with a single note on/after the 4th (3) beat. at 120bpm its a beat early

title: Relative Notes Not working
body:
An oversight caused when I recently changed how notes were handled.
They are treated as absolute in playback. Midi export still works.

title: Can't do Multiple inserts on effect leafs
body:
Just noticed this during cursor refactor.
if the leaf is empty, it's possible to insert multiple leafs at once, but  if there are more than one leafs in a cells, it only does 1 at a time.

title: Effects not looping
body: while fixing #204, I noticed that a pan that should've been sliding from side-to-side in a loop would work on the first pass, then stay at the last value for the rest of the passes.

title: SF2 Samples flipped
body:
Just noticed that the right-side samples are playing out of the left and vice versa. 
Easy fix but I'll deal with it for the next release so I can make sure I've also fixed any likely knock-on flippage.

title: Playback samplerate defaults to 44100, displays otherwise
body: Samplerate says 32000 hz but was playing at 44100

title: AutoScroll Broken
body: When a menu opens, the currently selected event *should* be active and visible. For some reason the menu isn't scrolling  when it's loaded.

title: cancelled move/copy takes up history entry
body: If I try to copy a tuned cell to a percussion line, it's successfully blocked but if I hit undo, nothing happens until i hit it again.

title: Battery drain
body: (posting for posterity) I've already fixed but when I recently changed how themes work, I unthinkingly put the current them in a MutableState and that was causing an infinite render loop.

title: Effects *aren't* blocking beat removal
body: Tried to remove a beat where 2 consecutive pan events, where the first is duration two, should have prevented the action but it didn't.

title: Odd sample rates in soundfonts cause strange noises
body: noticed this because of issue #195. an Oboe has sample rate of 44053hz and all of the samples sound weird in different ways.

title: Having a bad project in a directory will cause crash.
body:
Repro:
1. put a an empty file .json in a folder
2. set that folder as the project folder
3. crash

title: Velocity Dropdown Slider disables pitch sliding
body:
I'm in the process of writing tests for the effect widgets and found this.
Changing the velocity value of an event overwrites the slide values of the event in the widget.

title: Channel-Level effects can't be enabled while the same Line-Level effect is visible
body: Happens for any effect. If any line has  it visible, then the user won't be able to turn it on.

title: Latest configuration sometimes being forgotten
body: I changed how the configuration is shared between activities - somehow, sometimes the latest configuration isn't getting saved when activity is closed.

title: Permission
body:
On my OnePlus 9 Pro running Android 14, I'm not prompted for permission. 

Tested: closing and reopening the app, but the request doesn't appear.

title: Wearauthn support issue
body: Hello, the nfc did initially work with my Samsung Galaxy watch 6 classic fully updated but when adding via nfc on it, it says gym equipment not recognized even though wearauthn works for google passkey.

title: Solo2 (CTAP 2.0): Error during CBOR parsing
body:
While trying to login to bitwarden on GrapheneOS, I get the "\<app\> wants to access \<device\>" prompt, but then in the app it still tells me to connect a device.  In the logs, I see that the device is detected, but that there is some protocol issue that leads to the device returning [status code 0x12](https://fidoalliance.org/specs/fido-v2.0-id-20180227/fido-client-to-authenticator-protocol-v2.0-id-20180227.html#error-responses) to an `AuthenticatorGetAssertionRequest`.  The device is a solokeys 2, and has worked everywhere else it's been used, but there's always some chance it has a problem.  My current guess is this is a problem with the upstream microg implementation of fido2, but I thought I'd start with making an issue here for  visibility.  

Does that guess sound right?

Are the logs from this provider safe to share or is there any specific info I should be stripping out first?

## Description

I can register and authenticate using passkeys on my phone and on a YubiKey, but the same flows fail with a biometric FIDO2 key. As soon as I plug it in, an error message appears at the bottom of the screen:

> Received CTAP2_ERR_CBOR_UNEXPECTED_TYP… (truncated)

This blocks both registration of new credentials and authentication with existing ones on the biometric key.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Plug in the biometric FIDO2 key.
2. Attempt to register a passkey (or authenticate with an existing one).
3. Error appears; the flow cannot be completed.

## Expected behaviour

- Registration and authentication succeed, as they do with phone passkeys and the YubiKey.
- The full error message should be visible (it currently appears cut off, which makes diagnosis harder).

## Feature request – biometric verification flow

For biometric keys, the default user-verification method should be the fingerprint, not a PIN prompt. However, after roughly three failed fingerprint attempts, a fallback should kick in offering PIN + touch (user presence only). This covers cases where the user is wearing gloves or has wet fingers.

Ideally the fallback lets the user enter the PIN directly inline, with a prompt such as:

> «Touch the fingerprint sensor or enter your PIN.»

- GOS / version: 2026062801
- Driver / middleware version: 1.0.1
- Biometric key model: Trustkey G310

title: Security: ssh -y is too dangerous
body:
Using `ssh -y ` makes sync vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks, because known_hosts is not populated correctly and all server keys are accepted.

Attacker needs only to modify SSH server to accept all possible keys and then let a victim connect to the modified server. Syncopoli then happily uploads all data to malicious server.

MR !6 makes known_hosts file writable, but there is still a need to actually pair with the server on first connect...

title: Persistent GATT_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT with COLMI R10 (Android 16) - Connectivity vs. Sensor Sync
body:
### Please confirm that;

- [x] I have checked the [website](https://gadgetbridge.org) and [gadget list](https://gadgetbridge.org/gadgets/), and I didn't find this device mentioned there.
- [x] I have searched the [issues](https://codeberg.org/Freeyourgadget/Gadgetbridge/issues), and I didn't find this device mentioned there.
- [x] I have read and understood the [Codeberg Terms of Use](https://codeberg.org/Codeberg/org/src/branch/main/TermsOfUse.md) for images or other type of content that I included here.

### Which gadget are you requesting support for?

Colmi R10 ring

### Does this gadget have similarities to other gadgets?

_No response_

### Device information

Device Information:

Device: COLMI R10 (Bluetooth ID: 30:31:47:32:28:06)

App Version: Gadgetbridge (latest stable)

OS: Android 16 (SDK 36)

Problem Description:
The device experiences a "connect-disconnect" loop. While it occasionally syncs successfully (proving the driver works), it frequently falls into a GATT_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT cycle.

Key Technical Observations:

The 5-second Timeout: Logs show that Gadgetbridge/Android 16 gives up on the connection exactly 5 seconds after the attempt starts. This is likely too short for the R10's BLE stack to wake from deep sleep.

Successful HRV/VFC Sync: Contrary to some reports of missing sensors on Colmi devices, my R10 successfully syncs HRV (VFC) and Heart Rate data when the connection holds (average 37-38ms recorded). This confirms the driver is compatible; the issue is strictly the connection handshake stability.

Android 16 Aggression: The system seems to kill the GATT process prematurely. Even with "Auto-reconnect" enabled, the 64,000ms scheduling interval allows the ring to fall back into deep sleep, creating a loop of failed "wake-up" attempts.

Log Snippet:

00:13:06.695 INFO  n.f.g.s.b.BtLEQueue(15) - Attempting to connect to COLMI R10_2806
00:13:11.696 WARN  n.f.g.s.b.BtLEQueue(15) - Timed out connecting to GATT for COLMI R10_2806
00:13:11.745 INFO  n.f.g.s.r.AutoConnectIntervalReceiver - scheduling reconnect in 64000ms
Request to Developers:

Is there a way to manually increase the GATT connection timeout beyond 5 seconds for this device profile?

Could the reconnection interval be made user-configurable (lower than 64s) for devices that have aggressive power-saving sleep modes like this ring?

### Do you have logs?

_No response_

### Do you have the gadget and are you able to help us for testing?

Yes, I have the gadget and I'm willing to provide further feedback and help testing.

title: Live activity should not plot invalid heart rate
body:
it appears my miband returns "0" for about half the hr measurements and those are plotted resulting in a wild zigzag line going up and down from zero to valid value and back

In java/nodomain/freeyourgadget/gadgetbridge/activities/charts/LiveActivityFragment.java line 163 is a check for isValidHeartRateValue(heartRate) which causes setCurrentHeartRate(); not to be called.

However, in  getCurrentHeartRate() mHeartRate was previously set to "-1" to signal an invalid value and is returned by next calls. 
Where getCurrentHeartRate is callled in add entries there is no test for isValidHeartRateValue resulting in adding and plotting the bogus values.

Either in line 219 there should be a check for isValidHeartRateValue or as a quick hack getCurrentHeartRate() should remember and return the latest valid value to bridge over invalid measurements.

title: Mastodon API implementations in the various servers software
body:
As far as i've tested i came to this conclusions:

* Public posting works as expected on all 4 server types.
* Unlisted is shown as Public on Friendica.
* Followers-Only is shown as Direct on Friendica.
* Direct is posting only on Mastodon and Pleroma. It's not posting anything on Pixelfed and Friendica. Also workers aren't showing any error.

The latest is the most "dangerous" one. See the other [ISSUE](https://codeberg.org/silkevicious/fediphoto-lineage/issues/7) for explaination.

For the others, in my opinion, it's enough to add something in status config to clear the situation (a popup, a balloon, ...).

title: മലയാളം ലിപ്യന്തരണം keyboard and Browsers issue with കൂട്ടക്ഷരം
body:
മലയാളം ലിപ്യന്തരണം കീബോര്‍ഡ് ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ഗൂഗിളില്‍ കൂട്ടക്ഷരം വരുന്ന വാക്ക്/അക്ഷരം സെര്‍ച്ച് ചെയ്തതിനുശേഷം കൂട്ടക്ഷരം എഡിറ്റ് ചെയ്താല്‍ പിന്നീട് ആ കൂട്ടക്ഷരം മുറിയുന്നു.

ഉദാ: "കൂട്ടാന്‍" എന്ന് സെര്‍ച്ച് ചെയ്തതിനുശേഷം ട്ട എഡിറ്റ് ചെയ്ത് വീണ്ടും അതേ വാക്കോ അല്ലെങ്കില് കൂട്ടക്ഷരം ഉള്‍പ്പെടുന്ന വേറെ വാക്കോ type ചെയ്താല്‍ ട്ട യ്ക്കു പകരം "ട" അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ ക്ക യ്ക്കു പകരം "ക" ക്ഷ യ്ക്കു പകരം "ഷ" ഒക്കെ ആയി മാറുന്നു.

വീണ്ടും സെര്‍ച്ച് ചെയ്യണമെങ്കില്‍ ടാബ് ക്ലോസ് ചെയ്ത് വീണ്ടും സെര്‍ച്ച് ചെയ്യേണ്ടി വരുന്നു.

Issues noted in Google Chrome (not in Google search app) & Xiaomi Browser. Issue couldn't replicate in Mozilla Firefox or Opera Mini.

Followup Comment:  
അതെ. ഫയർഫോക്സിലും ഒപേര മിനിയിലും കൃത്യമായി പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നുണ്ട്.

ക്രോമിലാണ് ഈ പ്രശ്നം ആദ്യമായി കണ്ടത്. പിന്നീട് ടെസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്യുവാനായിട്ടാണ്
മറ്റ് ബ്രൗസറുകൾ നോക്കിയത്.

ഇപ്പോൾ ശ്രദ്ധിച്ചത്: ഗൂഗിൾ സെർച്ച് ടെക്സ്റ്റ് ബോക്സിൽ ഒരിക്കൽ എന്തെങ്കിലും
സെർച്ച് ചെയ്തതിനുശേഷം പുതിയൊരു കൂട്ടക്ഷരം വരുന്ന വാക്ക് ചേർത്താലും ഇതേ
പ്രശ്നം replicate ചെയ്യാൻ പറ്റുന്നുണ്ട്.

title: Screen sharing to FCast Receiver buffers indefinitely
body:
Hi, I was testing ClastLab as an alternative casting capability given I use a de-googled android phone.  It worked with casting images and video but not with screen or app window sharing.  It would just spin.  Sorry for the AI assistance but here's the summary of the troubleshooting that seemed to point to something that may be a bug/something to be addressed in the CastLab app itself. 

I'm happy to share additional details if needed. 

Thank you!

=========
### Screen sharing to FCast Receiver buffers indefinitely — H.264 SPS/PPS not repeated on IDR frames

I am using CastLab to screen-share an Android phone to FCast Receiver 2.1.5 on Android TV.

Normal media/file casting to the same FCast receiver works correctly. Screen sharing connects and launches the receiver player, but the receiver remains buffering indefinitely at 0:00.

#### Environment

* CastLab: current F-Droid build
* Android phone: Android 17
* Hardware encoder: `c2.exynos.h264.encoder`
* FCast Receiver: 2.1.5
* Receiver device: SEI Robotics / Homatics Box R 4K Plus
* Both devices on same LAN

#### CastLab logcat

The screen encoder initializes successfully:

```text
Encoder initialized: 540x1200 @ 2000kbps
Stream server started on port 9126
Encoder started
Screen capture started: 540x1200 on port 9126
```

The MediaCodec configuration contains:

```text
mime = "video/avc"
bitrate = 2000000
frame-rate = 30
width = 540
height = 1200
prepend-sps-pps-to-idr-frames = 0
```

The encoder produces codec-specific data containing SPS/PPS at startup:

```text
coded.init-data.value =
00 00 00 01 67 ...
...
00 00 00 01 68 ...
```

CastLab then sends:

```text
[FCast] Play: http://<phone-ip>:9126/stream (video/mp2t)
```

The FCast receiver connects successfully to the HTTP server.

#### MPEG-TS test

I captured the screen-share stream directly with:

```bash
curl http://<phone-ip>:9126/stream -o screen-test.ts
```

The resulting stream is approximately 2–3 Mbps H.264, but `ffprobe` repeatedly reports:

```text
non-existing PPS 0 referenced
no frame!
```

It eventually identifies:

```text
Video: h264 (High), yuv420p, 540x1200
```

FCast Receiver/ExoPlayer never recovers and remains buffering.

This appears to happen because Android MediaCodec emits SPS/PPS as codec-config data at encoder startup, while CastLab's encoder configuration has:

```text
prepend-sps-pps-to-idr-frames = 0
```

A receiver connecting after the initial codec-config buffer therefore begins receiving IDR/P frames without SPS/PPS available to initialize its H.264 decoder.

Would it be possible to enable:

```java
MediaFormat.KEY_PREPEND_HEADER_TO_SYNC_FRAMES
```

or its equivalent for supported encoders, or alternatively cache the encoder's codec-config SPS/PPS and prepend/inject it for each new HTTP stream client / IDR frame?

This should allow FCast/ExoPlayer and other clients joining the live MPEG-TS stream after encoding has begun to initialize correctly.

title: Launcher crashes when filtering app drawer (duplicate LazyColumn keys for multi-activity packages)
body:
## Summary

The launcher process crashes (unhandled exception → Android falls back to the system "Select a Home app" picker) when filtering the app drawer search bar. Reported via email with a screen recording; the reporter's trigger character was `f`, but the underlying cause is not specific to that letter.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the app drawer.
2. Start typing in the search bar to filter the list.
3. With certain installed apps present, the launcher crashes the moment the filtered list narrows.

Observed: launcher dies and Android shows the "Select a Home app" chooser.
Expected: list filters normally.

## Root cause

`AppDrawer.kt` keys the list items by `AppInfo.usageKey`:

```kotlin
items(filteredApps, key = { it.usageKey }) { app -> ... }
```

For normal apps `usageKey` is just the `packageName` (`AppInfo.kt`). The list is built in `LauncherViewModel.loadApps()` via:

```kotlin
val resolveInfoList = pm.queryIntentActivities(intent, PackageManager.MATCH_ALL)
```

`MATCH_ALL` returns **one entry per launcher activity**. A package that exposes **multiple launcher activities** yields multiple `AppInfo` objects with the **same `packageName`** (and `shortcutId == null`) → **identical `usageKey`**. The entries are never de-duplicated (`appList + shortcutList` are concatenated and sorted).

Compose's `LazyColumn` requires unique keys and throws `IllegalArgumentException: Key "<pkg>" was already used...`, which is unhandled and kills the launcher process.

### Why it only triggers while filtering (not on open)

`LazyColumn` builds its key→index map only for items near the visible window. In the full, usage-sorted list the duplicate-key entries sit far apart and are never composed together. When the user types, the filter collapses the list to a few matches, both duplicate-key entries fall inside the composition window simultaneously, and the duplicate-key check fires. For this reporter the offending package's activity label happened to match `f`.

## Suggested fix direction

- De-duplicate by a genuinely unique key, e.g. incorporate `launchIntent` (the activity name) into `usageKey` for non-shortcut entries, or `distinctBy { it.usageKey }` when assembling the list.
- **Migration caveat:** usage counts are persisted in SharedPreferences keyed by `usageKey`, so changing the key format affects existing counters and needs handling.

## Secondary risk (same area)

The auto-launch effect in `AppDrawer.kt` (launch when exactly one match remains) calls `LauncherViewModel.launchApp()`, where `context.startActivity(intent)` is **not** wrapped in try/catch (unlike the shortcut and other launch paths). A stale/unlaunchable single match would be a second unguarded crash path. Not the cause of this report, but worth guarding while in here.

---
*Reported via email.*

title: Private key passphrase managment
body:
Hi,
I have recently started using FTPClient and I especially appreciate its handling of public key authentication for SFTP.

However, I am confronted to some strange things. I was able to create a connection to my server and select the appropriate private key file.

I then checked the option to have the passphrase asked at connection. I am able to connect, but the prompt for the passphrase appears again each time I open a folder. I do not have to actually type it again, clicking OK is sufficient, but this is really a hindrance. I would have expected to be asked only once. I think this is a bug, since the passphrase seems to be actually remembered, but the prompt is displayed in spite of that.

Furthermore, I regret that SAF integration is not possible in this mode. It would be so nice to have the SAF integration ask for the passphrase upon access, and remember it for a given time or until told to forget it, in a fashion similar to what [OpenKeyChain](https://github.com/open-keychain/open-keychain) does with PGP keys.

title: Sharing files only works reliably the first time
body:
When I share one or more files via FTPClient (I use SFTP but perhaps this doesn't matter), this only works reliably the first time. If I want to share one more more files the second time, FTPClient briefly pops up but then just closes. I can get it to work again by force stopping FTPClient, then sharing.

Steps to reproduce:
- Open the image gallery (or anything else)
- Share a file via FTPClient, select the bookmark you want to send it to
- Open the image gallery again (or anything else)
- Share a file via FTPClient, and it just closes without doing anything

I think, but I'm not 100% sure, it also fixes itself after a while, and sharing again works exactly once.

## Description
<!--- Provide a detailed description to your issue itself, and why you consider it to be a bug -->

Aurora Store is extremely helpful. I am currently using it to help me downgrade my Android WebView and Chrome to help troubleshoot a bug in Chromium 136+.

However, one of the Google devs asked me to check the `chrome://media-internals` page, and I noticed that this page does not load when Chrome is installed by Aurora Store. It fails with _Developer UI module (dev_ui) is not installed_. Out of curiosity, this is the bug: https://issues.chromium.org/issues/420989249.

The same issue does not happen when installing Chrome from Play Store. Also, it does not happen when installing Chrome from the [APK Bundle](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/google-inc/chrome/google-chrome-135-0-7049-113-release/google-chrome-135-0-7049-113-android-apk-download/) through the [APK Mirror Installer](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.apkmirror.helper.prod). Note that when installing through APK Mirror Installer, `dev_ui` is indeed one of the modules that can be unselected (comes selected by default).

## Expected Behaviour
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->

To have Chrome `dev_ui` module installed like it does when installed from Play Store.

title: Conflation of vegetarian/vegan restaurants with those that offer vegetarian/vegan options
body:
### Describe the issue

OSM mappers use `diet:vegetarian=yes` to mean that a POI (e.g. restaurant) has some vegetarian dishes, and `diet:vegetarian=only` to mean that is is exclusively vegetarian. The same goes for vegan, halal, kosher, and other `diet:*=*` tags.

CoMaps supports vegetarian and vegan. `data/replaced_tags.txt` turns both `diet:vegetarian=yes` and `diet:vegetarian=only` into a generic "vegetarian cuisine", displayed as "Vegetarian" next to other cuisine types (e.g. Italian, Pizza, ..). The same happens for `diet:vegan=yes` and `diet:vegan=only`, which are turned into "Vegan".

This leads to a couple of issues
- When people speak about a “vegetarian restaurant” they normally mean a restaurant that only has vegetarian dishes, and a “vegan restaurant” is one that only has vegan dishes. Labelling a restaurant as "Vegan" in the UI could mislead users into thinking the entire menu is vegan.
- CoMaps doesn’t currently have a way of showing vegan/vegetarian restaurants, because a search for vegan/vegetarian shows all restaurants have some vegan/vegetarian dishes on the menu (if this has been tagged). This is useful in places where vegan/vegetarian food is rare, but it’s not very useful in places where it’s so common that pretty much every restaurant has the  `diet:vegetarian/vegan=yes` tag.
- It means a vegan/vegetarian user has no way of searching for vegan/vegetarian restaurants specifically.

In practice, vegans and vegetarians use HappyCow instead (https://www.happycow.net/) but that is closed crowdsourced data. I am thinking CoMaps could be much more useful for this group of users if it didn't conflate `=yes` and `=only`.

### Steps to reproduce

- Search for "vegetarian" or "vegan" in a city where POI coverage is good and the tags are well used (e.g. London) and there are a lot of search result
- POIs tagged `diet:vegetarian=yes` and `diet:vegetarian=only` are indistinguishable from one another, same for vegan

(See also screenshots)

### Expected behaviour

- For `diet:vegetarian=yes` the label should say "Vegetarian options" and for `diet:vegan=yes` it should say "Vegan options"
- For `diet:vegetarian=only` it should say something like "Vegetarian only" and for `diet:vegan=only` it should say "Vegan only"
- Searching "vegetarian" can continue to surface all POIs with a `diet:vegetarian=yes` or `=only` tag (ideally with the `=only`) ones highlighted, e.g. in a different colour, but there should be a way to limit the search to vegetarian or vegan restaurants/bars/cafes i.e. those with `=only`. For example, typing "Vegetarian only" or "Vegan only" into the search.

I am working on a PR to fix this, but I thought I'd open this issue first to see if there are any comments.

### Screenshots

Attached. The 100% vegetarian falafel place is indistinguishable in the UI from the French restaurant that has some vegetarian and vegan options (but most of the menu is meat-based).

Searching "vegetarian" in London returns hundreds of restaurants and cafes, and whether or not a given restaurant is found by the search is more to do with whether a mapper thought of adding the `diet:vegetarian=yes` tag. Finding fully vegan/vegetarian restaurants is not possible in CoMaps although the data is in OSM.

### System information

CoMaps version 2026.08.31-14-Google

### Additional context

- This was previously discussed in https://github.com/organicmaps/organicmaps/issues/8265 where @hbond commented and said it should be supported.
- CoMaps issue #1761 is about making the "hidden" search queries like vegetarian and vegan more discoverable. My PR wouldn't touch this, and just change the POI display and Search work for vegetarian/vegan places
- CoMaps issue #4876 is related but about the editing UI. This bug report and my proposed PR would focus on POI disply and Search

title: Existing reacts/emotes are unusable if not made by the local server until manually reacting
body:
This has been a bugbear for me for quite a while, so I will pipe up and point it out now.

If you try to react with an emote on a post that has been made by a remote server, the error "WAFRN doesn't have that emoji" pops up. This will happen even if your server *does* have that emote. Emotes on remote emotes only work if they are based on Unicode (the keyboard emojis), when you manually add a react from the react picker, or someone else on your server adds the matching react.

This behavior is out of step with the web client which will add emotes no matter who first added them.

body:
## What the issue is

Hi, I was setting up the app and it mentions, that I should host my own searxng instance, if I wanted to use that as a search backend.
So I fired up their default docker container on my VPS, connected to the VPN and tried to access it.

I can access it fine from web browser (mobile and PC) but I cannot seem to connect via the app.
I have it running under my vpn local IP:
`http://10.8.0.1:8888`

The app tells me, I need to make sure to enable API access. I enabled all search formats (`html`, `json`, `csv`, `rss`). What setting is meant by API access?

Do I need to run using https?
Do I need it to run on basic ports (80/443)?

## Steps to reproduce

Run the docker from the [searxng docs](https://docs.searxng.org/admin/installation-docker.html)
```
docker run --rm \
             -d -p 8888:8080 \

             -e "INSTANCE_NAME=my-instance" \
             searxng/searxng
```
then try to connect from it from the local network. I also updated the settings for the additional formats and restarted the container.

## What is the current behavior?

The app setup shows "Unsupported Instance" (in German)

I would like it to connect to my local searxng instance and use that as the search backend.

[BUG-09] Correction du Regex IPv6 pour adresses compressées
body:
### 🚨 Problème constaté
Le pattern d'expression régulière dans `Constantes.kt` rejette certaines formes valides d'adresses IPv6 compressées (ex: `::1`, `2001:db8::1`).

### 🛠️ Solution / Correctif proposé
Mettre à jour le pattern `IPV6_PATTERN` avec une Regex conforme à la RFC 4291 capable de valider toutes les variantes de compression `::` ainsi que les adresses link-local avec index d'interface.

title: [BUG-08] Restauration de la détection des plages RFC 1918 (Classes IP)
body:
### 🚨 Problème constaté
La méthode `MainInfo.getClassOfIp()` dans le module `app/` n'identifie plus les plages privées (RFC 1918) ni le Loopback.

### 🛠️ Solution / Correctif proposé
Réintégrer le contrôle des plages d'adresses privées :
- `10.0.0.0/8` -> Réseau privé (Classe A)
- `172.16.0.0/12` -> Réseau privé (Classe B)
- `192.168.0.0/16` -> Réseau privé (Classe C)
- `127.0.0.0/8` -> Loopback

title: [BUG-07] Sécurisation du parsing JSON dans NetworkRequest
body:
### 🚨 Problème constaté
L'instanciation de `JSONObject` sur les réponses HTTP peut lever une `JSONException` non interceptée en cas de réponse malformée ou d'erreur serveur (ex: 404, 500), provoquant un crash de l'app.

### 🛠️ Solution / Correctif proposé
Encadrer l'analyse de la réponse HTTP dans un bloc `try-catch (JSONException)` et gérer proprement le cas d'erreur avec un retour clair pour l'utilisateur.

title: [BUG-02] Correction de la hauteur de ProgressBar dans Fragment LocationInfo
body:
### 🚨 Problème constaté
La `ProgressBar` du chargement de la géolocalisation possède un `layout_height` incorrect qui étire l'élément sur tout l'écran ou déforme le layout.

### 🛠️ Solution / Correctif proposé
Définir `android:layout_height="wrap_content"` dans `res/layout/fragment_location_info.xml` pour les deux modules (`Ipcalc/` et `app/`).

title: [BUG-01] Suppression du Toast IPv6 intempestif
body:
### 🚨 Problème constaté
Lors de la saisie ou de l'analyse, un Toast d'avertissement IPv6 s'affiche en boucle (spam) à chaque mise à jour du champ.

### 🛠️ Solution / Correctif proposé
Introduire un drapeau d'état (`isIpv6WarningShown`) ou gérer l'affichage de l'avertissement de manière Inline dans un `TextInputLayout` au lieu d'utiliser un Toast répétitif.

title: [Feature request] progress indicator
body:
Hi! Thanks for this amazing app, based on our previous conversaion here is a draft for a progress indicator feature.

It would be nice to have some indicator for the conversion process.

Upon hitting convert it should show some spinner or progress bar and some text about that the remote service is being queried. Also in case of failure some error reason should be shown, e.g. if the service rejected the request or is not available, or there is no network connection on the phone, etc.

In the case of sharing into the app, or opening the app with an url via the default open links feature in android, I think it would be beneficial to show immediately even the url that was passed (the easiest might be to pre-populate the input field...)

As currently the app does not show the url neither that it loads, so the user can become uneasy quickly, not really knowing if something is wrong, or will anything ever happen.

Cheers!
Csaba

title: Sync error combining "disable bill deletion" setting from Cospend and deleting bill on Moneybuster
body:
Hi,
I am still new to Moneybuster and Cospend on my Nextcloud instance, but so far, it does fulfill all of my needs.
I must say I am really pleased having found Moneybuster, and feel really grateful for the time I know (as an android developer myself) it is taking you to develop and maintain this app.

I am running:

1. **Android version:** Android 11
2. **Device**: Nokia 8.1
3. **System language**: English
4. **App version:** v0.1.15
5. **App source:** F-droid
6. on sync with a project on **Nextcloud v22.2.3** and **Cospend V1.4.3**

**Context:**

My wife told me she accidentally deleted some bills on Moneybuster, and had found no way to get them back.
I looked into it, and discovered that a simple swipe left on a bill deletes it, with a timed snackbar allowing you to undo the move.
(Thankfully this action is not on the right swipe, which is often even more easily accidentally triggered when opening the left menu-drawer...)

Exploring the Nextcloud Cospend app, I found a way to disable bill deletion, which removes the trash button on each bill there.
[disable_deletion_cospend](/uploads/03bed7f5dcd53ee8ce73044deb071b36/disable_deletion_cospend.jpg)

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. enable "disable bill deletion" setting in Cospend project
2. delete a bill in Moneybuster project => bill is deleted in Moneybuster
3. (optional, if auto sync is not activated) sync project on Moneybuster

**Result:**

The project sync fails with a _404 Not Found_ error.
This error is actually a _Forbidden_ error, as the attached displayed message in the popup informs you then.
You have to remove the project from Moneybuster, and then add it again. Afterwards it's back with the bill you tried to delete.

**Expected result:**

I feel like the most user-friendly mechanism here would be for Moneybuster to somehow "know" that bill deletion is not allowed in the project, and prevent it somehow. Ideally removing the swipe-left-to-delete interaction, at least displaying immediately an error. In any case, the bill should not be deleted, and the user should be informed if an attempt has been made to delete it (optional if the attempt is impossible in the first place)

**FWIW:**

I don't think implementing a recycle bin mechanism is easily doable, especially since I don't see the equivalent in Cospend.
I don't know if the "disable bill deletion" setting can be synched along with the project from Cospend to Moneybuster, but if it's not, maybe just allowing users to set it on each instance running Moneybuster would at least prevent accidental deletion, and the following sync error.!

Again, thank you very much for your time!
Shiva

title: Not all athletes from a country shown in athlete search
body:
**Bug description**

When searching for athletes by country, not all athletes that compete under the flag of one country are shown.

This is because the ISA maintains two fields per athlete: `country` and `nationality`. If your country of residence differs - like for me - from your nationality, this results in you being shown as running for your residence country. For Switzerland this currently affects at least 3 athletes, I haven't checked other countries.

This is because ISA's API function `getAthletes` returns only the `country` but not the `nationality` field. The latter is only included in the response for `getAthlete&getAthlete&athleteID=4293`.

For the display in the `AthleteDetails` we can just update the local athlete data to show the correct country/nation.

But for search - unless we want to prefetch and make ~400 requests - the best way is probably to ask ISA to improve their API :(

--------
**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Search for _Germany_ in athlete list

**Actual result:** Thore Goebel is not in the results

**Expected result:** Thore Goebel is in the result when searching for _Switzerland_

--------

title: Vulnerability: Server can MITM E2EE when client logs in again
body:
After logging out and in again, the client uses the server-provided public key to encrypt data.
This allows the server to MITM the client by providing a malicious public key.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Register a new FMD Server account
2. Log out from the account
3. Log in to the account

### Actual behaviour

During registration, FMD Android locally generates a keypair, and stores the private and public keys to settings. It uploads the plaintext public key and the encrypted private key to the server.

During login, FMD Android retrieves these values from the server. It trusts them blindly and stores them to settings.
See https://gitlab.com/fmd-foss/fmd-android/-/blob/v0.11.0/app/src/main/java/de/nulide/findmydevice/net/FMDServerApiRepository.kt?ref_type=tags#L317-L327

Later, FMD Android uses the plaintext public key from the settings to encrypt data that it uploads to the server.

### Why is this an issue

During login, the server can provide a malicious public key, for which it knows the private key.
Thus it can MITM the E2EE: it can decrypt any data FMD Android uploads and re-encrypt it with the real public key.

### Expected behaviour

FMD Android should NOT trust the data provided by the server.

In particular, FMD Android should ignore the public key. It should only look at the private key. The private key -- if it decrypts successfully -- can be trusted.

It can be trusted because the private key is encrypted/decrypted with AES-GCM, which is an [AEAD](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Authenticated_encryption). Only the user knows the symmetric password (from which the AES key is derived). Due to the integrity provided by the MAC in the AEAD, the server cannot tamper with the ciphertext holding the RSA private key without causing AES-GCM decryption to fail.

### Metadata

- FMD Android version: 0.11.0

We should migrate the allowlist to store `+497712345` (without spaces), to be more robust. In rare cases, when number ranges are reassigned by countries, the spaces in the pretty print may change.

Therefore, the storage should use no spaces, but in the UI we can still render them with spaces.

## Cause

This `cellParas.maxOf` crashes with `NoSuchElementException` when `cellParas` is empty:
https://gitlab.com/fmd-foss/fmd-android/-/blob/v0.16.1/app/src/main/java/de/nulide/findmydevice/locationproviders/CellLocationProvider.kt?ref_type=tags#L145

### Other information

This bug was introduced by https://gitlab.com/fmd-foss/fmd-android/-/merge_requests/485.

This only happens if the device has been in airplane mode long enough. I noticed it overnight. Hence the "wait for a while" step.

If the device recently had a cell connection, then our [CellUtils class falls back](https://gitlab.com/fmd-foss/fmd-android/-/blob/v0.16.1/app/src/main/java/de/nulide/findmydevice/utils/CellUtils.kt?ref_type=tags#L223) to asking Android for the cached CellInfo. Then it does not crash because the list is non-empty.

```
CellInfo update failed with errorCode=2 message='com.android.internal.telephony.CommandException: com.android.internal.telephony.CommandException: RADIO_NOT_AVAILABLE' Falling back to cached CellInfo.
```

Therefore, you need to wait long enough so that Android no longer returns any cached CellInfo in our fallback call.

title: [Bug]: Home macro status label "over" is misleading for fat
body:
### What happened?

## Description

`macro_status_over` (strings.xml) is applied uniformly to all four
macro cards on Home (protein, carbs, fat, fiber) whenever today's
value exceeds the stored target:

    <string name="macro_status_left">%1$s%2$s left</string>
    <string name="macro_status_over">%1$s%2$s over</string>

For fat, the target itself is documented as a floor, not a ceiling. From docs/CALCULATION_METHODS.md (MACRO-F):

    Standard: 0.6 × weight(kg) g/day.

And from the policy table:

    Fat 0.6 g/kg — Keep — Practical minimum-fat heuristic; not a clinical prescription.

Nothing in the formula or the policy notes treats this number as an upper bound — carbs are the variable that absorbs the rest of the calorie budget (MACRO-C). So a user who eats more than 0.6 g/kg of fat, while staying within their calorie goal, gets told they have "X g too much" on a value the app's own design treats as a healthy minimum, not a limit.

## Suggested fix

Either give fat its own status wording (no "over" state when under the calorie goal), or clarify in the label/tooltip that this is a minimum target, not a maximum.

## Parity note

This touches a nutrition formula / target-display concern, so per CONTRIBUTING.md it should be checked against both Kotlin and the PWA mirror (`web/app/src/lib/chompass-core/`) if the fix changes shared formula logic — though the specific bug here is UI-label semantics (`macro_status_over` in strings.xml), not the formula itself.

## Relevant files
- android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml (macro_status_over)
- docs/CALCULATION_METHODS.md (MACRO-F section)

### How can it be reproduced?

1. Standard diet mode, default fat target (0.6 g/kg).
2. Log meals whose total fat exceeds the computed target for the day while staying under the calorie goal.
3. Home screen shows the fat bar/chip as "X g over".

### App version

5.1.1

F-Droid

title: Each retention (forgetting) policy affects everything in the repository
body:
When looking at the code for https://codeberg.org/dawdyd/resticopia/issues/47 I noticed that `restic forget` commands generated by the app use `--keep-within` but not any other filtering option, so they apply (modulo date/time) to every snapshot in the repository even though they are configured per-folder.

For example, folder A is configured with "Retain: 30 days" and folder B with "Retain: 5 days", both backing up into the same repository. A 6-days-old snapshot of folder A would incorrectly be removed whevener folder B is backed up. So would snapshots made by another machine entirely.

Instead, every `forget` command should use both `--host` and `--path` to only apply to relevant snapshots.
